# Volume 2 timeline

## I An Irate Neighbor

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is interrupted while studying on her doorstep by her angry new neighbor, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), whose oatfield was invaded by Anne's cow. After arguing with him, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) pens the cow up and later discusses the incident and village gossip over tea with [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028)_

**[Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md)** — Mrs. Lynde expresses her skepticism about [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's son coming to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), as well as Anne's plans to start a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Despite Mrs. Lynde's warning that people dislike being improved, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) remains determined to pursue the idea alongside [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Mrs. Lynde also shares that Anne's friend [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) has been hired to teach at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P50](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0050), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P52](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0052), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P55](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0055), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057)_

## II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Martin](../character/martin.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Shearer](../character/shearer.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) plans on their drive home from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) when they spot a Jersey cow trampling Mr. Harrison's oat field. Believing the cow is her own nuisance Jersey, [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) impulsively sells the stray cow on the spot to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) for twenty dollars. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers [Dolly](../character/dolly.md) still in the barnyard and realizes she accidentally sold Mr. Harrison's cow, prompting her to head over to his house with the money and a cake to confess.

_Sources: [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P12](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0012), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P24](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0024), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P35](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0035), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P42](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0042)_

## III Mr. Harrison at Home

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to Mr. Harrison's home to confess that she accidentally sold his Jersey cow, but he receives the news calmly, insults from his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) notwithstanding. After trading cows and sharing tea and cake, the two form an unexpected friendship. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home relieved and shares the outcome with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P8](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0008), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P20](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0020), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P35](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0035)_

## IV Different Opinions

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) debate the ethics and effectiveness of corporal punishment in school teaching on the eve of the school year. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also doubts her plan to rule by affection rather than the rod, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) anxious about her upcoming first day of teaching.

_Sources: [v2 IV Different Opinions P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 IV Different Opinions P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007), [v2 IV Different Opinions P35](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0035), [v2 IV Different Opinions P41](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0041)_

## V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Clair Donnell](../character/clair-donnell.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Morley, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Prillie Rogerson](../character/prillie-rogerson.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) begins her first day of teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, meeting her students—including the sullen [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) and the imaginative [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)—and dealing with minor classroom infractions. After school, Mrs. H. B. Donnell confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with pretentious demands about her children's names, but [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) cheers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) up by gifting her wild orchids. Returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her day with [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020)_

## VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Catherine Andrews](../character/catherine-andrews.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss the newly formed [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) as they drive through the countryside to canvass for hall repairs. They visit several local residents, dealing with the pessimistic Miss [Eliza](../character/eliza-andrews.md), receiving a secret donation from Catherine, helping Dan Blair mix a cake, and navigating Mrs. Theodore White's extreme cleanliness to gather subscriptions.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P36](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0036)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue canvassing [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) residents, visiting Mrs. Theodore White and several other neighbors with varying degrees of success. Learning that [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md) has just had a son, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cleverly visits him while he is overjoyed and secures a five-dollar donation. Later that evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to ask for a contribution, but he refuses.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P37](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0037), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P49](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0049), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P50](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0050), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056)_

## VII The Pointing of Duty

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) chat at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) about their teaching experiences and future aspirations. After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home tired and reveals that her sick relative [Mary](../character/mary-joe.md) Keith cannot care for her twins much longer. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) convinces a hesitant [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to take in the Keith twins out of a sense of duty.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P1](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0001), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P12](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0012), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P23](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0023), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P33](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0033)_

## VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

**Aid Society, [Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), Green Gables, [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) brings the twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith, home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) quickly displays his mischievous and unruly nature. Over the next few days, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) causes trouble by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck at church, making [Dora](../character/dora.md) fall into a pigpen, and hiding a toad in Marilla's bed.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md)** — [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he put a toad in Marilla's bed. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) quickly sneaks into Marilla's room and uses a shovel to remove the toad before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) can find it.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P56](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0056), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P61](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0061), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P62](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0062)_

## IX A Question of Color

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [John Andrew](../character/john-andrew.md), [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md), [Peter Sloane](../character/peter-sloane.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Roger Pye](../character/roger-pye.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) debate Mrs. Lynde's virtues and discuss the village hall painting project. Later, [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) paints the hall a bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with paint numbers, causing dismay among the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Despite the hideous result, public sympathy turns in favor of the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), and the community rallies around them.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_

## X Davy in Search of a Sensation

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), Green Gables, [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — After walking home from school, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) panicking because [Dora](../character/dora.md) is missing, and the household fears she may have fallen into the well. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse and realizes [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) hid her and lied about it. When confronted, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) tearfully apologizes after realizing lying hurts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to forgive his deceit while punishing him for the prank.

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P9](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0009), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lectures [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) about his behavior after he admits to skipping his prayers to test Marilla's warning. Later downstairs, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) laugh over the situation and discuss their difficulties and fondness for [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) despite his antics.

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P75](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0075), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P79](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0079), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P82](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0082), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P87](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0087)_

## XI Facts and Fancies

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Clair Donnell](../character/clair-donnell.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Nora](../character/nora.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md)** — In a letter to [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares amusing stories and student compositions from her teaching job. She recounts humorous classroom incidents, answers to her creative prompts, and includes compositions written by her students, notably admiring [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's imaginative letter about his fictional rock friends.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_

**[Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md), [Nora](../character/nora.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md)** — In his letter, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) describes his imaginary rock friends at the shore, including [Nora](../character/nora.md), the [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md), and the [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md). He details a magical voyage to the sunset with the oldest [Twin Sailor](../character/twin-sailors.md) before adding a postscript clarifying that the letter isn't actually true.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P44](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0044), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P46](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0046)_

## XII A Jonah Day

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Clair Donnell](../character/clair-donnell.md), [Joe Sloane](../character/joe-sloane.md), [Prillie Rogerson](../character/prillie-rogerson.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Chester Sloane](../character/chester-sloane.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md)** — In a bad mood from a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally causes fireworks to explode in the schoolroom and subsequently whips [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) after he puts a mouse in her desk. She goes home heartbroken over her bad day, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts her. The next morning, Anthony treats [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with new respect, and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) later confirms that the whipping gained his approval.

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P36](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0036), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049)_

## XIII A Golden Picnic

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) meet by the stream and make plans to celebrate Anne's chosen spring birthday on Saturday. When Saturday arrives, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) go on a woods walk, naming a hidden pool and exploring back lanes. Eventually, they discover Hester Gray's forgotten garden, where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) shares the touching romantic history of the spot.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P0](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0000), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P8](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0008), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — After reflecting on Hester Gray's story and imagining her appearance, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) spend the afternoon exploring the woods and eating lunch by a brook. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her poetic thoughts about nature and souls, which [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) finds hard to grasp. As evening falls, the girls return home after a wonderful day, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later leaves narcissus blossoms on Hester's grave.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P56](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0056), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P61](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0061), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P66](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0066), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P73](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0073)_

## XIV A Danger Averted

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — Mrs. Lynde tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about preparations for the Ladies' [Aid](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) bazaar and asks to borrow Miss Barry's platter, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns Marilla's sight is improving. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) receives a letter from the twins' uncle extending their stay, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) remembers a conversation with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) after catching him eating plum jam. Later, at an Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) announces that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence to a medicine company for painted ads, prompting a committee of girls to try unsuccessfully to talk him out of it.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) plead with [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) not to rent his fences for advertising, but he refuses. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally witnesses [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md) offering Judson a political bribe. To ensure [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) keeps quiet and doesn't ruin his reputation, Judson agrees to drop the advertisement plan and tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) can have their way.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P65](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0065), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P66](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0066)_

## XV The Beginning of Vacation

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes the school year and walks to the graveyard, joining [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) as they share their feelings about memory, grief, and imagination. After placing flowers on the graves, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets Mrs. Allan, and they walk home together while reflecting on teaching, ideals, life choices, and the value of friendship.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P2](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0002), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P26](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0026), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P45](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0045)_

## XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) talks to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about his funny ideas about heaven until [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) arrive from the garden. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then shares the exciting news from Priscilla's letter that author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will be visiting [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for dinner, and she immediately begins planning the meal and preparations.

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P0](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0000), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014)_

## XVII A Chapter of Accidents

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), Allans, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) frantically decorate [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and prepare a elaborate dinner for the arrival of the famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). However, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) accidentally destroys the lemon pies, the guest of honor fails to arrive, and a series of mishaps ruins the meal and results in Miss Barry's expensive platter being broken. A later letter reveals Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect on her bitter disappointment.

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P10](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0010), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P57](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0057), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — After the guests depart, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns via a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will not be visiting [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) due to a sprained ankle. Sitting on the porch at twilight, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Anne's tendency toward high hopes and deep disappointments, how to replace Aunt Josephine's broken platter, and neighborhood gossip about Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md).

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P65](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0065), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P67](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0067)_

## XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)** — [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) questions [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about where sleep goes before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) alerts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to Diana's signal fire. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to Diana's house and learns about a potential willow-ware platter at the Copp place in [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale). The next day, the girls travel to [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale), where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally breaks through the roof of an outhouse while peeping through a window to inspect the platter, trapping herself until Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp returns and chops her free.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P0](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0000), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P16](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0016), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P34](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0034), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) explains her actions to [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp and agrees to purchase the desired willow-ware platter for twenty-five dollars. After enjoying tea and learning that [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) plans to marry, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive home along the [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road) with the platter in hand.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P56](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0056), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P62](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0062), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P63](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0063), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P64](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0064)_

## XIX Just a Happy Day

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) for tea while his grandmother is away, reassuring him about his imaginative ideas. She returns home to handle [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) before bedtime and then encounters [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) by the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble).

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P2](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0002), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P23](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0023), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) boasts to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about being good by sharing his jam bread with [Dora](../character/dora.md) before kneeling to say his prayers. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) by Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), where they discuss the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Improvement Society's progress and school developments. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her busy schedule for the next day.

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P44](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0044), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P47](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0047), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P63](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0063)_

## XX The Way It Often Happens

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md)** — While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is away, [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), covered in feathers and having accidentally dyed her nose red, quickly cleans herself up. With help from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hosts a successful and delightful visit for her distinguished guests.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P23](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0023), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P33](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0033), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)_

## XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md), [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to teaching school, where [Dora](../character/dora.md) is frightened by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's stories about a ghost relative. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk through the woods to go to [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#west-grafton), but lose their way and discover [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), the quaint stone home of Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her young helper, Charlotta the Fourth. Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) warmly invites them to stay for a imaginary tea party she had set up to combat loneliness.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share tea with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her maid Charlotta the Fourth at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) explains her imaginary party and the origin of her echoes. After [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) demonstrates the echoing tin horn and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) explains her maid's given name, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) inadvertently mentions [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) briefly inquires about [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's son before bidding the girls a wistful goodbye.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P81](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0081), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P87](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0087)_

## XXII Odds and Ends

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — At the breakfast table, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Anne's visit with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and gossip about old town affairs while trying to keep [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) in check. Later, word arrives that [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) has died and left money in trust for the twins, ensuring that [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) can remain living at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) permanently.

_Sources: [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P0](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0000), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025)_

## XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), [Irving](../character/irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) on a wintry evening, and over tea and candy, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) recounts her long-ago romance and quarrel with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). A month later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) introduces Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and the two immediately form a fond friendship during their visit.

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P17](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0017), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026)_

## XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Isabella Andrews](../character/isabella-andrews.md), [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Uncle Abe](../character/uncle-abe.md)** — Uncle Abe's storm prediction comes true with violent force, bringing a devastating hail storm to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and the twins rush home from school as [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) suffers broken windows and stripped vegetation. The storm kills Mr. Harrison's parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) and ruins local crops and young trees, though [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) find solace in the fact that Mr. Boulter's unsightly old house burned down.

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P54](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0054)_

## XXV An Avonlea Scandal

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Isabella Andrews](../character/isabella-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learn that Mr. Harrison's long-estranged wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), has arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after seeing a newspaper joke about his supposed remarriage. Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) investigates the situation, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to hear his side of the story.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P32](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0032), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md)** — Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) how he and his wife [Emily](../character/emily.md) separated in the past over household neatness, grammar nagging, and his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md). [Emily](../character/emily.md) returns from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) with Mrs. Lynde, welcomes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) radiantly, and later admits her own past foolishness as she walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home. Back at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Mrs. Lynde comments on the situation before leaving, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) puts a sleepy [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P60](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0060), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P65](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0065), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

## XXVI Around the Bend

**[Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md)** — Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's death, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposes that [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can go to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepts the plan and resigns her teaching position, which causes great sorrow among her students and her friend [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P24](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0024), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md)** — [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) expresses concern about the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaving for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). They talk about their romantic ideals, Ruby Gillis's suitors, and their lifelong friendship, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) warmly acknowledges.

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P42](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0042), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P45](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0045), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060)_

## XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dresses in a new pale green dress and converses with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Dora](../character/dora.md) before leaving for [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) then walk to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where they eat lunch and visit with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Charlotta the Fourth in the garden. Afterward, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) plays with the echoes while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) set out to pick early strawberries for tea.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P37](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0037)_

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — Charlotta the Fourth expresses concern to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about Miss Lavendar's unusual despondency and apathy. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promises to come stay for a week during her vacation to help cheer Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) up. Meanwhile, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) bond over their shared experiences with imaginary dream-people before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) head home.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P62](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0062)_

## XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and helps Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for her reunion with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). The two eagerly wait in anticipation as Mr. [Irving](../character/irving.md) arrives at the house in the evening.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P47](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0047), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059)_

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) excitedly prepare for [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's visit to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) arrives, reconnecting with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) before entering to meet [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). After an anxious wait in the kitchen, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) watch [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) walk in the garden together, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to happily predict a wedding.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P73](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0073)_

## XXIX Poetry and Prose

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for college while helping Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) plan her wedding, receiving visits and commentary from [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and Charlotta the Fourth. She discusses the romance of the marriage with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) before discovering [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) together in the garden. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) later visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide her engagement to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect on love, change, and her own future.

## XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), Allans, [Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Irving](../character/irving.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) help prepare [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for Miss Lavendar's wedding to [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). After a joyful ceremony and farewell send-off, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) share a quiet, romantic moment together outside the stone house as a new chapter of life begins.

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P39](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0039)_
